110395900.explanation: Perimeter black-cell count uses bottom=ceil(n/2) (the ROW count) for the bottom edge instead of a count over m columns depending on the parity of n, and the left/right side counts ignore which corner colours are black, so ring black-cell totals are wrong for general n,m.

154018525.explanation: Prints (nm-(n-2x)(m-2x))//2: half of ALL cells outside the x-th inner rectangle (rings 1..x, both colours halved), not the black cells of ring x only.

16218702.explanation: Ring counting adds both end cells per inner row and (y2-y1+1)//2 plus a parity fix on edge rows; when the ring degenerates (single row/column, y1==y2 or x1==x2) cells are counted twice, and for y2<y1 it counts phantom cells instead of 0.
